hero_headline: A community that backs you. For life.
hero_headline_html:
A community that backs you.
For life.
about_html: The GİRVAK Fellow Program is designed to equip young people with an entrepreneurial mindset, empowering them to drive transformation in their communities and beyond. While fellows don't need to be entrepreneurs, we believe that thinking like one, being proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient is essential to creating meaningful change.

application.label: application criteria
paragraphs: Be a university student in Türkiye and currently in your 3rd year or above
Be between the ages of 17 and 24

selection.label: how we select
paragraphs: Our selection process is unlike any other. It's not a test you pass, it's a journey in itself.
As you move through it, you learn by doing, and you come out knowing yourself a little better.
We don't look at your business idea. We don't look at your grades. We look at who you are.

what_to_expect.name: Two years to grow
what_to_expect.desc: a learning journey centered on self-discovery and purpose

what_to_expect.name: Backed all the way
what_to_expect.desc: a scholarship that supports you throughout the program, so potential leads the way

what_to_expect.name: Every month
what_to_expect.desc: FellowUp events built to spark confidence, clarity, and curiosity.

what_to_expect.name: People who've been there
what_to_expect.desc: mentorship from leading entrepreneurs, investors, creatives, and changemakers

what_to_expect.name: Beyond one path
what_to_expect.desc: exposure to diverse career paths, from entrepreneurship to impact-driven work

what_to_expect.name: The whole ecosystem
what_to_expect.desc: access to Türkiye's innovation ecosystem and a powerful alumni network

alumni_headline: once a fellow, always a fellow
alumni_headline_html: once a fellow, always a fellow.
alumni_intro: Becoming a fellow isn't a two-year chapter. It's the start of a select, lifelong network of people who get you, grow with you, and have your back, always.
alumni_bullets: Instant, lifelong access to a community of 450+ alumni
Direct connection to extensive network of mentors, industry leaders, and ecosystem partners
Access to annual events and meet-ups held across Türkiye and the EU
Direct fast-track nominations to major national and international awards
Free event tickets and corporate tech perks
Visibility and curated access to high-level conferences, acceleration programs, and funding opportunities

challenger_hero_headline: Your first step into the entrepreneurial world
challenger_hero_headline_html:
Your first step
into the entrepreneurial world
challenger_paragraphs: The Challenger Program introduces first and second-year university students to the wide horizon of opportunities that life, careers, and entrepreneurship have to offer.
Designed as an early discovery track, the program inspires young talents to explore different paths, gain foundational entrepreneurial skills, and start shaping their own future.

challenger_application.label: application criteria
paragraphs: Be a university student in Türkiye and currently in your preparatory, 1<sup>st</sup> or 2<sup>nd</sup> year
Be between the ages of 17 and 24

challenger_selection.label: how we select
paragraphs: Our selection process is unlike any other. It's not a test you pass, it's a journey in itself.
As you move through it, you learn by doing, and you come out knowing yourself a little better.
We don't look at your business idea. We don't look at your grades. We look at who you are.

what_youll_do.text: Get equipped with the core principles of entrepreneurship
Take part in open conversations on real-world challenges
Meet inspiring entrepreneurs from our alumni network
Grow curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking skills
